preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 50000, inclusive.
The number of elements N in each test case is between 4 and 100000, inclusive.
Each element a_i in the sequence is an integer with an absolute value of at most 10^9.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 500000
preconditions.description: The total number of elements across all test cases does not exceed 500000.

postconditions.expression: Each output sequence b_i is an arithmetic sequence differing from the input sequence a_i in at most one position.
postconditions.description: The output must be an arithmetic sequence with a common difference d, and it must differ from the input in at most one position.
For each test case, there must be at least one arithmetic sequence that differs from the input sequence in at most one position.
